value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "Informed by Remillard’s (2005) framework on the participatory relationship between teachers and the curriculum, I attended to the new or deeper knowledge teachers developed through their navigation of the customized lesson and the original lesson."
